SELECT 'memo' AS sourceType, m.id AS sourceId, m.title AS title, COALESCE(m.content, '') AS content, m.remind_at AS plannedAt FROM memos m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.remind_at IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'trip' AS sourceType, t.id AS sourceId, t.title AS title, CONCAT(t.place, ' · ', t.category) AS content, t.start_at AS plannedAt FROM trips t WHERE t.user_id = #{userId}
ORDER BY plannedAt ASC
